cohort: 22,374 deliveries in Sichuan province, China, between 1 January 2009 and 31 December 2010
finding: HBsAg positivity during pregnancy was associated with a higher risk of gestational diabetes mellitus, postpartum hemorrhage, intrahepatic cholestasis, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: HBsAg positivity during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of Caesarean section.
